content:
Alex: Thanks for the all-hands — quick follow-up thread on API / Console / Optimize timelines. Can @Maya or @Jordan confirm the concrete release windows and the main risk areas we should flag for teams? Also need a short canary/fallback plan for Dedicated customers.

Maya: High-level timeline we’re aiming for (subject to change): API GA -> mid-June; Console revamp -> rolling July launches; Optimize beta -> late-August. Biggest risks: model compatibility regressions, infra autoscaling under backpressure, and Console UX polish for large orgs.

Jordan: Clarify: when you say "mid-June" for API GA, is that a global GA or phased? And when will SDKs land so product teams can start integrating?

Maya: Phase GA: 2-week phased rollout. Week 1: self-serve accounts + internal apps; Week 2: paid accounts + Dedicated. Regions: NA -> EU -> APAC (APAC depends on regional infra readiness). SDK v2 (breaking changes) targets week of 2025-06-09, beta SDK next week.

Sam: From infra POV we need explicit canary %s and autoscaler thresholds. If we hit a qps spike during canary we should auto-fallback to a slower model variant instead of failing requests. Also need a capacity reservation plan for Dedicated customers during GA.

Jordan: +1 on fallback to compatible model. Can you put a minimal canary config so PMs know the defaults?

Sam: Sure — baseline proposal:
```
canary:
  percent: 5
  duration: 48h
  rollback_on_errors: 5%
  fallback_model: model-compat-v1
```
This is conservative and buys us time to observe latency/error signals.

Lia: Docs questions: what’s the deprecation window for the old API? We need to schedule migration guides and sample code for the new streaming behavior. Also will Console show a migration banner?

Maya: Plan is 90-day deprecation for old endpoints after GA announcement, with a clear migration doc and code snippets. Console will show a banner to org admins during the 90-day window and a migration checklist in the UI.

Alex: Important to call out SLAs and Dedicated promises — Sam, please confirm what latency SLOs we can guarantee during canary vs full rollouts so sales & success have accurate comms.

Sam: Can guarantee 99th pctl latency SLO for GA traffic assuming reserved capacity is provisioned. During canary we will mark SLOs as 'best effort' and include a note in release notes. I’ll add exact numbers in the rollout doc this week.

Lia: I can draft the migration guide and a one-pager for CSMs. Will need a demo video and sample repos (2 languages). Timeline: guide + repo by June 5?

Maya: Yes, June 5 for docs + sample repos is realistic if we get SDK betas by next week. Jordan, can you coordinate SDK changelog and a deprecation checklist for integrators?

Jordan: On it. I’ll post the SDK changelog and migration checklist in #devex by Friday.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: api-endpoint v2 -> prod on 2025-06-10T03:00:00Z (canary rollouts enabled).

Alex: Great — last requests: 1) put the canary config and fallback model in the public rollout doc, 2) call out known risks and mitigation steps, 3) sync with sales/CS on GA messaging. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

Maya: Will do. I’ll upload the rollout doc and timeline after the SDK beta is cut.

Sam: I’ll attach autoscaler playbook and dedicated capacity plan to the same doc.

Lia: I’ll queue the migration guide and sample repos.

Jordan: Changelog + checklist heading to #devex Friday.

Alex: Okay closing — post any follow-ups here and tag me if something blocks GA.

Sam: Ack.

Maya: Ack.

Lia: Ack.

Jordan: Ack.
